claim.text: Sinusoidal positional encoding uses sin(pos / 10000^{2i/d}), so nearby positions have a similar encoding.

spec.explain: Illustrative toy for arXiv 1706.03762 showing the sin curve over pos. The limit of nearby pos values staying close on the curve keeps a similar encoding.

var dv = Math.pow(10000, e); return Math.sin(p / dv); } var expo = 2 * dimi / dimd; var divisor = Math.pow(10000, expo); var angle = pos / divisor; var enc = Math.sin(angle); var x0 = 48; var y0 = 28; var pw = w - 48 - 158; var ph = h - 28 - 62; function X(p) { return x0 + p / 50 * pw; } function Y(v) { return y0 + ph / 2 - v * ph * 0.44; } var k = 0; var p = 0; var v = 0; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.strokeStyle = "#d8cfbe"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(0), Y(0)); ctx.lineTo(X(50), Y(0)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(0), Y(1)); ctx.lineTo(X(50), Y(1)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(0), Y(-1)); ctx.lineTo(X(50), Y(-1)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); for (k = 0; k <= 140; k++) { p = k / 140 * 50; v = valAt(p); if (k === 0) { ctx.moveTo(X(p), Y(v)); } else { ctx.lineTo(X(p), Y(v)); } } ctx.stroke(); var pos2 = pos + 1; if (pos2 > 50) { pos2 = pos - 1; } var v2 = 0; if (pos2 !== pos) { v2 = valAt(pos2); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(pos), y0); ctx.lineTo(X(pos), y0 + ph); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(pos2), y0); ctx.lineTo(X(pos2), y0 + ph); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(X(pos), Y(enc), 6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(X(pos2), Y(v2), 5, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(pos), Y(enc)); ctx.lineTo(X(pos2), Y(v2)); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("pos " + pos + " enc " + fmt(enc), x0, y0 + ph + 20); ctx.fillText("near " + pos2 + " enc " + fmt(v2), x0, y0 + ph + 36); ctx.fillText("pos", X(50) - 10, y0 + ph + 20); var lx = x0 + pw + 12; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("divisor", lx, 52); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("" + fmt(divisor), lx, 68); ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("angle", lx, 94); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("" + fmt(angle), lx, 110); ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("encoding", lx, 136); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("" + fmt(enc), lx, 152); ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("sin(pos/divisor)", lx, 184); ctx.fillText("divisor 10000 pow", lx, 200); ctx.fillText("gap " + fmt(enc - v2), lx, 222); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("i " + dimi + " d " + dimd, x0, 16); }
